description: Use this read-only, no-login tool when an owner or sponsor asks for an infrastructure project readiness checklist, preparation evidence matrix, missing permits/authority evidence, or a go/no-go decision register before commissioning feasibility, procurement or investment. Returns public links and seven evidence-gate names without collecting project data. It does not review project documents, establish title, certify feasibility, arrange financing, provide regulated advice, or create a mandate.
name: get_project_readiness_evidence_register
title: Get free infrastructure project readiness checklist and decision evidence register
